ex.en: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins

forms.gloss: to set out; to be fluent

ex.en: So they set out, while lowering their voices
And if they decide on divorce - then indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing
And for divorced women is a provision according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous
